notes.title: Version 1.1.9
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.9 (16 December 2024)[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed landmines position in Twin Dragon addon
[*]Fixed 4k+ resolution support
[*]Fixed Twin Dragon logo overlapping credits
[*]Fixed menu items clipping on non-full HD resolutions
[*]Fixed invisible mines with voxels=on option
[*]Fixed incorrect brightness slider in video options
[*]Fixed issues related to DPI settings
[*] The cursor is now hidden after input from gamepad
[*]UI fixes
[*]Stability fixes
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed landmines position in Twin Dragon addon
[*]Fixed menu items clipping on non-full HD resolutions

[*] The cursor is now hidden after input from gamepad

notes.title: Shadow Warrior Classic Redux Update Released
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2
• Fixed: animation and intermission screen problems with some models of NVidia video cards
• Fixed: brightness reset after loading saved game
• Fixed: music not started after loading saved game
• Fixed: usermaps selecting issue
• Fixed: video playback with wrong frame-rate on some systems
